headline: A 1999 executive order by President Clinton on how the federal government deals with invasive species.
what_it_does: This order deals with invasive species, which are plants, animals, or other living things that spread into places where they are not native. No summary was provided, so the details of what it requires are not covered here. Based on its title, it sets federal policy on this issue.

who_it_affects.how: Executive orders direct the work of federal agencies, so this order likely shapes how they handle invasive species.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 3, 1999. Executive orders usually take effect when signed.
